title: Automated Project Triage via Outlook Email
business: Project managers handling high-volume client communications in Outlook.
problem: Manual sorting and prioritization of incoming client emails leads to delayed responses and missed project requirements.
solution: The Outlook Email plugin allows the AI to programmatically access and triage inbox contents, enabling the identification of urgent project requests and the drafting of initial responses based on email context.
steps: Authenticate the Outlook Email plugin within the ChatGPT interface to grant necessary read/write permissions.
Invoke the plugin to fetch recent unread messages from the primary inbox folder.
Use the AI to analyze message content for keywords related to project milestones or urgent client blockers.
Generate draft replies or categorize emails into specific project folders based on the AI analysis.
Review and finalize the AI-suggested actions before sending or moving the emails.
outcome: Improved response consistency and reduced time spent on manual inbox triage, allowing managers to focus on high-priority project tasks.
limitation: The plugin relies on the current state of the inbox; it cannot process encrypted emails or those requiring multi-factor authentication prompts, which can be checked by verifying if the plugin returns an access error for specific protected threads.
